title: Company-level OKR Sprint Gateway and Initiative Swimlane Prioritization
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Scope: Create a lightweight, repeatable 'Sprint Gateway' that sits at the start of each biweekly sprint for company-level OKR initiatives. The gateway enforces swimlane prioritization across Eng, Product, Design, and SRE so we consistently allocate limited cross-functional capacity to the highest-impact company initiatives.

Why this work: Over the last two quarters we've observed repeated downstream rework and missed SLAs when multiple company initiatives converge on shared infra/observability work and serving runtime tuning. Existing roadmap artifacts document outcomes but lack a concise gating checklist and a clear swimlane map for execution owners. This ticket defines the gate, decision rubric, success measures, and the rollout plan for Q2.

Deliverables:
- Sprint Gateway checklist template (acceptance criteria, risk signals, rollback plan) for company-level initiatives.
- Initiative Swimlane Prioritization matrix (capacity slices per role per sprint) and a visualization template for Console.
- Lightweight triage playbook for conflicts, escalation points, and temporary resource reallocation.
- Integration with Console's initiative dashboard so PMs can see sprint gating status and lane commitments.

Out of scope: Detailed team-level sprint planning (this ticket coordinates cross-functional commitments at initiative level only).

Success metrics: Reduced number of cross-initiative infra conflicts by 60% quarter-over-quarter; 90% of company-level initiative sprints have a completed gate checklist before sprint kickoff; post-release incidents attributable to missed pre-sprint validation decrease by 50%.
acceptance_criteria: Gate checklist template reviewed and approved by Eng, Design, SRE, and Security
Swimlane matrix created for top 8 company initiatives and published to Console
Playbook includes explicit escalation owners and time-to-response SLAs
Console dashboard shows gate status (ready/block/needs-info) for every initiative for next two sprint windows
Two pilot initiatives use the Sprint Gateway for one sprint each and produce retro notes
